speaker: (the ostler)
text: She's sour, master. And the knot on the off bag has walked.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The knot is my wife's. I'll tie it again as she tied it.

speaker: (the ostler)
text: That's a Stratford knot, if I know yards. I won't teach her manners.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Don't. The knot is the lesson, and it is not yours. Water, and no improvements.

speaker: (the ostler)
text: She'll stand. Sour is what grass does.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then she is herself. I'll not buy her a sweeter nature at Shipston.
